video_title: ESPN wanted Ryan Clark to choose between them & the Pivot

quotes.speaker: Ryan Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Ryan Clark on ESPN's ultimatum regarding The Pivot and NFL Inside
quotes.excerpt: My first offer on my last contract, two of the stipulations were, I could no longer do the pivot.
quotes.quote: My first offer on my last contract, two of the stipulations were, I could no longer do the pivot and I could no longer host Inside the NFL. And crazy enough, if I agreed to those things, the new sports show does not exist because it is through the pivot and it is in partnership with NFL Films, who I was hosting Inside the NFL with. And when they sent that offer over, I had an agent and the agent comes to me and they were like, what do you want us to say? And I was like, nothing. I was like, because clearly this is not a serious offer and those are the two things that have to be off the table for for me to work there. I won't give that up.
quotes.social_post: Ryan Clark reveals ESPN tried to force him to quit The Pivot and Inside the NFL in his last contract offer. He called the proposal not serious and refused to give up his outside projects, leading to his departure from the network.

quotes.speaker: Ryan Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Howard Schultz's reaction to Ryan Clark's departure from ESPN
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know much about you, but I did see the sports world stop when you got let go.
quotes.quote: I didn't know much about you, but I did see the sports world stop when you got let go. And it made me wonder, who is this person? And he said, so for four days, all I did was study you. He said, I believe in what you stand for. He said, I believe in the way that you go about your life and he said, and I think that you are a brand and you are a star and I want to be a part of it.
quotes.social_post: Ryan Clark shares how Howard Schultz reached out after his ESPN exit, telling him he spent four days studying his work and believes he is a star. It is a revealing look at how the industry viewed his departure.

quotes.speaker: Ryan Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred Taylor's vision for the future of The Pivot
quotes.excerpt: I want this to be whatever Ryan needs it to be for him.
quotes.quote: The question was, where do you see this in five years? And they said, before you answer, I want to tell you what Fred's answer for what was. And Fred's answer was, I want this to be whatever Ryan needs it to be for him.
quotes.social_post: Ryan Clark reflects on the loyalty of his Pivot cohost Fred Taylor, who told potential partners that his goal for the show is simply to be whatever Ryan needs it to be for him.

quotes.speaker: Ryan Clark
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Crowder's belief in Ryan Clark's potential
quotes.excerpt: Before we did this show, I believed in you. Now, I believe you can do anything.
quotes.quote: I was talking to Channing the other day just about where we were going, how I see him and ways I feel like we could utilize him best as we start to build this thing out. And he is like, man, he is like, before we did this show, I believed in you. He said, now, he is like, I believe you can do anything.
quotes.social_post: Ryan Clark discusses the growth of his partnership with Channing Crowder, noting that their success has evolved from initial belief to a shared conviction that they can accomplish anything together.
